title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Wednesday, 4 November 2026
description: Drax, Brookfield and Radiant unveil a £20 billion AI data centre plan for North Yorkshire, Australia's corporate regulator warns super funds over complaint-handling failures, Queensland continues cleaning up after destructive supercell storms, and the Gold Coast hands its aquatic centres to a single private operator. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
